row:
These lectures provide general legal information to help chiropractors operate a business and minimize the risk of malpractice lawsuits. These lectures are for the Successful Chiropractic Practice class at Parker University. 
These vodcasts provide only general legal information. They are not legal advice and do not create an attorney-client relationship.
